context:
Goal: the Chrome extension says CH Post wherever it names itself.
Problem (rule): the extension's options page has a letterhead line that reads MANIFEST (extension/options.html, line 21); your ruling renames the extension's MANIFEST name, but a decision keeps the in-app masthead as MANIFEST, and this page uses the app's letterhead layout, so only you can say which this line is.
Based on (ruling): your 2026-11-21 19:54 CST answer on the leftover names: rename every leftover name to CH Post (filed in git).
Based on (ruling): decision masthead-is-not-project-name keeps the in-app masthead as MANIFEST.
Based on (read): a reviewer of the rename found this one line; two tests pin the change.
Departs from: main shows MANIFEST on that line — option b changes it to CH Post, option a leaves it.
Waiting on: your answer; the rename stays a draft meanwhile and the other lanes run.
